chain.label: SSA did not account for single human error
chain.trigger: Scaled Composites' failure to consider and protect against the possibility that a single human error could result in a catastrophic hazard to the SpaceShipTwo vehicle

chain.label: No design barrier/annunciation against premature feather unlock
chain.trigger: The SS2 feather system had no design barrier that prevented a flight crewmember from erroneously unlocking the feather during the transonic region, and the system provided no annunciation on the MFD to prompt pilot action

caused_by.evidence: no safeguards were built into the feather system design because Scaled counted on the pilot 'to do the right thing' and dealing with redundancies was 'complex'

chain.label: Copilot lacked recent powered-flight vibration/load experience
chain.trigger: the copilot did not have recent experience with the vibration and loads that occurred during the flight...the copilot had not flown SS2 under power since PF01 in April 2013

chain.label: Copilot unlocked feather at ~0.82 Mach instead of required 1.4 Mach
chain.trigger: the copilot began moving the feather lock handle to the full unlocked position just after the 0.8 Mach callout...instead of waiting until SS2 reached the required speed of 1.4 Mach

caused_by.evidence: Scaled did not recognize and mitigate the possibility that a test pilot could unlock the feather early

the copilot appeared to be leaning forward and into a downward unlocking motion with his left arm and shoulder, which was likely the result of the vibration and loads that he experienced with the rocket motor ignited

chain.label: Uncommanded feather extension in transonic region
chain.trigger: the aerodynamic and inertial loads imposed on the feather flap assembly were sufficient to overcome the feather actuators...the feather extended uncommanded, causing the catastrophic structural failure

caused_by.evidence: at 1007:29.5, both the left and right feather lock positions transitioned from locked to not locked...the feather started to move at 1007:30.6

chain.label: Vehicle folded about feather hinge line under aerodynamic pitch-up loads
chain.trigger: The pitch rate increased rapidly, and the vehicle essentially folded in half about the feather flap hinge line, causing a catastrophic structural failure

caused_by.evidence: the loads imposed on the vehicle were sufficient to overcome the feather actuators...the forward end of the vehicle then began to pitch up

chain.label: SS2 in-flight structural breakup
chain.trigger: SS2 broke up into multiple pieces during a rocket-powered test flight

caused_by.evidence: the vehicle essentially folded in half about the feather flap hinge line, causing a catastrophic structural failure

chain.label: Wreckage impacted terrain over 5-mile area
chain.trigger: impacted terrain over a 5-mile area near Koehn Dry Lake, California

chain.label: Pilot seriously injured, copilot fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot received serious injuries, and the copilot received fatal injuries

caused_by.evidence: the pilot was thrown from the vehicle while still restrained in his seat
The copilot was found restrained in his seat with the cockpit wreckage...cause of death was multiple blunt force trauma
